records.title: ArtiFixer: Enhancing and Extending 3D Reconstruction with Auto-Regressive Diffusion Models
records.reason: The abstract addresses 3D reconstruction artifacts with autoregressive diffusion and view synthesis, not language model inference.

records.title: Steering at the Source: Style Modulation Heads for Robust Persona Control
records.reason: The paper localizes persona steering to three attention heads and preserves generation coherence, but its claimed computational advantage is relative to fine-tuning and it does not measure inference throughput, memory, or latency; the connection to inference-efficiency remains indirect.

records.title: MICON-Bench: Benchmarking and Enhancing Multi-Image Context Image Generation in Unified Multimodal Models
records.reason: The abstract introduces a multi-image context image-generation benchmark and evaluation-by-checkpoint, not inference efficiency.

records.title: Pixels Don't Lie (But Your Detector Might): Bootstrapping MLLM-as-a-Judge for Trustworthy Deepfake Detection and Reasoning Supervision
records.reason: The abstract focuses on deepfake detection and reasoning supervision; no inference cost, memory, latency, or serving method is claimed.

records.title: SEMixer: Semantics Enhanced MLP-Mixer for Multiscale Mixing and Long-term Time Series Forecasting
records.reason: The abstract proposes an MLP-Mixer for long-term time-series forecasting; it does not concern language models or their inference.
